_about: Sound side of the Juice event bus (Docs/JUICE.md), played by res://assets/audio/juice_sfx.gd (installed by Juice). Generated by assets/audio/_src/tools/juice_sfx_build.py; edit that file. Keys resolve through audio_index.json.

ambience._about: juice_sfx.gd plays the bed for the current WorldRoot.world_id when the world sets no ambience_key (or an old single-layer loop listed in upgrade), and fades it out when the world goes away.
